﴿By al-'Asr (the time)﴾: that is, time (al-dahr); or the period from after the sun passes its zenith until sunset; or the 'Asr prayer.
﴿Indeed, mankind﴾ — that is, the human species — ﴿is in loss﴾ in its trade.

﴿Except those who believe and do righteous deeds﴾ — for they are not in loss; ﴿and enjoin one another﴾ — each of them urges the others ﴿to the truth﴾ — that is, faith; ﴿and enjoin one another to patience﴾ — in obedience, and in refraining from disobedience.
